description: This file defines the application routing logic for a Flutter app, mapping route names to corresponding screens or widgets. It manages navigation within the app by generating routes based on route names and arguments.

classes.name: AppRouter
classes.description: A class responsible for generating the application's navigation routes based on route names.

methods.name: onGenerateRoute
methods.description: Returns a route factory that generates routes based on the provided route settings and arguments.

methods.name: buildRouter
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of AppRouter, allowing for dependency injection or future extensions.

methods.name: _material
methods.description: Helper method to create a MaterialPageRoute wrapping a widget.
